slides.eyebrow: If you only remember one thing
slides.sub: A free holiday market, a museum full of decorated trees and a student dance show. All open Sat. Nov. 21 and Sun. Nov. 22.
slides.source: Arts Council of Princeton; Morven Museum & Garden; Princeton University (2026)

slides.title: Artist Winter Village
slides.body: Local artists and makers sell gifts from little chalets, run by the Arts Council of Princeton. More vendors join on the weekend.
slides.source: Arts Council of Princeton (Week 2, Nov. 19 to 22, 2026)

slides.title: Festival of Trees at Morven
slides.body: 17 community partners decorated the trees and mantels. Vote for your favorite. Open through Jan. 10.

slides.title: Princeton Dance Festival
slides.body: More than 50 Princeton students perform new and repertory dance works. Sunday's 2 PM show is a relaxed performance, so it's OK to move around or make sounds.

slides.title: One weekend in Princeton
slides.tip: The market opens at noon, so tour homes in the morning. Then park in the Spring Street Garage.
slides.source: Arts Council of Princeton via happeningnext.com (2026)
